independence.method: The reviewer reimplemented the class, full-code, exit, concurrency, cross-axis and projection logic without using check-d9-v1.8.py as the semantic oracle. The reviewed checker was imported only after the review harness independently verified every executable predecessor pin.
independence.authoredCheckerBoundary: Green normal and selftest runs are supplemental checker-scope evidence only and do not override independently reproduced counterexamples.

verdict.statement: The v1.8 semantic delta mostly reconstructs, but the checker executes an unverified predecessor before checking its pin, and the supposedly authorized-custody-specific branch has no source discriminator. Those are architecture trust and scope-honesty blockers, not missing test polish.

exactV17Projection.method: Removed the v1.8 contract, new golden, invariant and X11; restored v1.7 metadata, exit-class text, remedy absence, reference derivation, conformance claims, peer-review and limitation arrays; compared the complete object.

blockingFindings.finding: check-d9-v1.8.py executes check-d9-v1.7.py at module import through V17 = _load_v17_checker(). Pin verification is deferred until check(), after the predecessor has already executed.

isolatedProbe.method: Copied the exact D9 files to a temporary directory, added a marker side effect to the predecessor checker, and invoked the unmodified v1.8 checker with python3 -B.

blockingFindings.consequence: A changed or malicious predecessor checker gets code execution before the checker establishes that it is the pinned authority. The later red finding detects drift but cannot undo the execution.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Remove every module-level predecessor import. Hash all artifact and executable transitive inputs before the first spec.loader.exec_module or other evaluation, load V17 only after a clean pin result, and add an isolated side-effect mutation proving a pin mismatch prevents execution. Prefer compiling the already-hashed bytes or rehashing immediately after load to close the check/read gap.

blockingFindings.finding: The derivation branch is described as authorized-custody-loss-specific and asserts that an unrelated admitted Run precondition does not satisfy it, but the executable predicate contains only commandKind, admission, lifecycle, domainCondition and rejectionCause. No source or provenance axis exists, and additionalProperties=false forbids adding one at the call site.

independentProbe.checkerSelftestLimitation: The authored unrelated control changes rejectionCause to precondition-failed, so it assumes the very upstream source classification that the doesNotBroaden claim purports to establish.

blockingFindings.consequence: An implementer must invent whether D9 owns authorized-source validation or accepts a normalized generic unsatisfiable finalization precondition from RT/E8. That is a week-one cross-surface fork.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Either encode and validate a closed source discriminator, or state honestly that the branch is generic over host-derived admitted unsatisfiable finalization preconditions and place source proof in the owning RT/E8 contracts.

sourceSpecificityOptions.assessment: Mechanically distinguishes authorized custody loss, but expands the closed axes contract, forces every D9 producer and golden to choose a provenance value, and couples the generic exit taxonomy to a retention-owned fact. Use only if distinct sources require distinct D9 automation remedies.

Less structural churn than a new field, but still embeds a retention-shaped distinction in the generic mapper and changes all language implementations. It remains unnecessary while every admitted frozen-target impossibility has the same REQUEST.UNSATISFIABLE/fresh-Attempt remedy.

RECOMMENDED. Define the predicate as every host-derived admitted unsatisfiable finalization precondition. Keep REQUEST.UNSATISFIABLE, exit 2, terminal ExecutionId and fresh-Attempt remedy. Make authorized custody loss one source-specific consumer profile, and require RT/E8 to prove the seven retention facts before emitting the normalized axes tuple.

repairRecommendation.selectedRationale: The taxonomy is remedy-oriented. Authorized expiry and any other frozen authoritative target that cannot be satisfied have the same caller action; adding a source axis creates a cross-surface fork without changing class, code, exit, identity or retry semantics.
minimumD9V19Delta: Remove or rewrite authorized-source exclusivity and doesNotBroaden claims so the mapper scope matches its executable predicate.

Declare the upstream producer obligation: rejectionCause=unsatisfiable on an admitted finalization path is emitted only after the owning domain contract proves the frozen authoritative target cannot be completed.
Retain the existing axes, predicate, class/code/exit, branch order, four CoreCompletion rows and source-specific golden as a consumer profile.
Move V17 loading behind a successful all-transitive-pin verification and add the no-side-effect-on-pin-failure probe.
Project exactly to v1.8 except for the closed scope-honesty and loader-order repair, and obtain a fresh independent review.
